text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Blue (left axis): half-hourly power at Donington Primary substation, in MW (negative flow would be export). Orange (right axis): CAMS solar irradiance arriving on a horizontal plane, in W/m². Days run from Monday (left) to Sunday. Scope: the four weeks with the highest and lowest clear-sky index (CAMS irradiance over CAMS clear-sky irradiance) among June, July, December, and January weeks since 2022 with no logged switching closure.'
